what: A leaf flies along a dotted loop path drawn in the margin, turning with the slope of the path — one lap in 7.5s easeInOutQuad (fades in over the first 1.5s, stays 4.5s, fades out over 1.5s), rests 2.5s at the end, then repeats. With dir: reverse it runs backwards in 8.5s (2.5 · 5 · 1s) with a 3.5s rest — attach one to each of two paths in alternation so the leaves pass in turns

options.dir: When reverse, runs the path backwards (default length·pause also become 8.5 · 3.5)
options.look: hidden: Uses only the path without drawing the dotted line
options.[data-fx-part=path]: Road — a single path inside the svg (drawn as a dotted line)
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: Thing that travels along the road (leaf image) — if there are several, they travel together

from.where: index.html .as-anime-p-a (three dotted looping paths below the Hero and above Access — original anime.js 3.2.1 motion path: opacity 0→1 1500ms · 1 4500ms · →0 1500ms, translateX/Y·rotate = path, easeInOutQuad 7500ms, loop, endDelay 2500 / .leaf_01._reverse 2500·5000·1000ms, 8500ms, direction reverse, endDelay 3500)

note: The path shape is the SVG path on the user side. The original loop path was redrawn fresh, tracing only the silhouette
